summary.text: Willis Curdy is a Democratic member of the Montana State Senate representing District 49 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election; Brad Tschida, a Republican, is also on the ballot for the seat.
Curdy is a former teacher and U.S. Forest Service pilot who served in the Montana House of Representatives from 2015 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Willis Curdy was born in Corvallis, Montana, lives in Missoula, and graduated from Corvallis High School.
He earned a B.A. in history from the University of Montana in 1971 and a master's degree in education from the same university in 1987.
His career experience includes work as a pilot with the U.S. Forest Service and as a teacher in Missoula County Public Schools.
Curdy represented Montana House District 98 from 2015 to 2023 before joining the State Senate.
In the 2025-2026 session, he was assigned to the Agriculture, Livestock and Irrigation; Business, Labor and Economic Affairs (vice chair); and Natural Resources committees.
